    THE HISTORICAL EXPERIENCE WE ARE BUILDING TOWARD

    Cockpit actions, in mission context.

    Apollo 11’s crew used checklists, DSKY entries, switches and hand controllers. During P64, Armstrong checked manual attitude response; later he used P66 during final descent. That sequence is different from our synthetic target exercise.
